propositions: Material-pin and close-review enforcement policies must be enabled in rebar.toml while library defaults remain false, allowing legacy unpinned attestations to pass both gates without backfill or migration.
End-to-end lifecycle tests must prove direct and transitive invalidation occurs only after actual narrow material changes, with unchanged successful re-review producing no downstream propagation.
Outgoing depends_on and inbound blocks references must normalize to one canonical prerequisite pin/evaluation without eager backfill or graph-wide invalidation events.

Execution-phase plan review, in-progress-to-open reset, code-only close freshness, enable/disable/re-enable cycles, and deleted/archived target handling must be verified through public lifecycle surfaces.

Fixture verification requires both policies enabled true, four gate-health cases with deterministic exit codes/status transitions and exact reason tokens, and a structured JSON evidence object recording configuration and test outcomes.
No eager backfill, graph-wide invalidation event, new pin command, ordinary-list output change, or stored relation migration must be introduced.
